newsitem.title: THAILAND: Siam Commercial Bank downplays Moody's report.
newsitem.headline: Siam Commercial Bank downplays Moody's report.

text.p: Siam Commercial Bank Plc said on Friday that Moody's possible downgrade of its A2 long-term foreign currency bond and deposit ratings would not have a major affect on its borrowing costs.

"There will be some impact on the bank's cost of funds, but not significant. The bank's funding from offshore sources represented only 10 percent of total funding," the bank's senior vice-president Prakit Padipasen told reporters.
Moody's said on Friday it had placed under review for possible downgrade the A2 long-term foreign-currency bond and deposit ratings of five Thai banks including Siam Commercial Bank Plc.
"The Moody's review of possible downgrade is normal. We have to accept that the current economic condition raises the amount of commercial banks' loan problems," Prakit said.
Siam Commercial Bank expected to see deposit and credit growth of about 20 percent this year, he added.
